name: mcp
description: Exposes the profile tool services to MCP clients over newline-delimited JSON-RPC on stdio.

mcp.description: One MCP server over the base's stdio pump: {op:"ready"} answers null before the client speaks; {op:"message", line, instance} answers one JSON-RPC line, or null for a notification. `instance` names the attached client the line came from; every sender that omits it shares one instance.

record_usage.doc: Persist an automatic usage journal for every dispatch.

tools.doc: Exact `tool.*` keys this server exposes. Empty means every `tool.*` event in needs, so the composition alone decides the surface.

cwd.doc: Working directory tool calls resolve against.

band.doc: Withhold the schema of every tool that is not hot; list it by name and summary in the `tools` meta-tool.

hot.doc: Tool names always sent with their schema while the band is on.
